About Us

Established in 1946, Teys Australia is a beef processing and food production business. We are best known for providing quality Aussie beef to customers here in Australia and around the world. 

With operations across 14 locations in Qld, NSW, Victoria, and South Australia, we are the second largest beef processor and exporter in Australia, employing over 5000 passionate people who drive our success, and bring their very best to work every day. 

Together, we focus on feeding people and enriching lives. Join us!

About the Role

Teys Australia is seeking qualified Mechanical Fitters to join our Maintenance team based at our Wagga processing site in New South Wales. The role will be responsible for providing repair and maintenance services on a daily basis, ensuring two way communication on environmental matters, maintaining downtime to a minimum, as well as following Workplace, Health and Safety policies and procedures. 

About You

It is essential that you have the following:

Trade qualification
Willing to work on a rotating shift basis which covers mornings, afternoons and nights with occasional weekend work and public holidays
Medium/strong hydraulic experience (fault finding)
Medium/strong Pneumatic experience (fault finding)
Welding skills in TIG, MIG and ARC
Experienced in overhauling pumps
Fault finding package machines
Current drivers licence.
Familiar with VEMAG and Multivac equipment
What’s in it for You

Attractive hourly rate starting from $50.23
Access to a variety of discounts: meat products, health insurance and retailers
Service recognition awards 
Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counselling services for you and your family
Opportunities to upskill and advance your career in meat production, maintenance, or management roles.

If you are looking for an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment within a growing business offering excellent career development and opportunities, we encourage you to APPLY today.

result.description:
## Network Administrator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and security of our organisation's network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in network administration, a methodical approach to troubleshooting, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across all levels of the business. This role suits a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering reliable, efficient IT services.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain network hardware, software, servers, and workstations, ensuring systems are kept up to date and performing optimally
- Monitor network performance on an ongoing basis, identifying and resolving issues proactively to minimise disruption to business operations
- Diagnose and troubleshoot network faults, emergencies, and connectivity issues, documenting resolutions and maintaining accurate records of all incidents and modifications
- Develop, maintain, and update procedures and documentation for network inventory, configuration changes, and maintenance instructions
- Manage user accounts, access permissions, and password policies in line with the organisation's security standards and compliance requirements
- Provide network programming and scripting support to address specific business needs and improve the efficiency of network operations
- Administer and support servers, printers, and personal computers, ensuring hardware resources remain reliable and fit for purpose
- Evaluate and implement upgrades to network infrastructure, recommending improvements that align with business growth and evolving technology requirements
- Deliver helpdesk support and technical assistance to end users, resolving issues in a timely manner and escalating complex problems where necessary
- Conduct user training and produce clear guidance materials to build internal capability and promote best practice use of network systems
- Maintain network security protocols, including firewall management, intrusion detection, and vulnerability assessments, to safeguard organisational data and systems
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to coordinate service delivery, procurement, and project implementation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Proven experience in a network administration or systems administration role within a corporate or enterprise environment
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, infrastructure components, and technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, and firewalls
- Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, and managing servers, switches, routers, and associated network hardware
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond to anomalies
- Solid understanding of network security principles, including access control, patch management, and risk mitigation
- Experience maintaining technical documentation, network inventories, and fault resolution records to a high standard
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work methodically under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or equivalent
- Experience with virtualisation platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and hybrid network environments
- Experience working within ITIL frameworks or other structured IT service management methodologies
- Exposure to scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible to streamline network operations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive, forward-thinking team that values continuous learning and invests in your professional development through training and certification opportunities
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and challenging infrastructure projects that will broaden your technical expertise and keep your skills at the cutting edge
- Join an organisation with a strong culture of collaboration, where your contributions are recognised and your ideas are encouraged
- Competitive remuneration package with long-term career pathways and opportunities for progression within a growing business
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

result.description:
On behalf of our client, we are looking for a full-time, experienced Heavy Duty (HD) Diesel Fitter. 

The Heavy Duty Diesel Fitter is responsible for carrying out mechanical maintenance, inspections, fault diagnosis, and repairs on heavy duty mobile plant, machinery, and production equipment used in industrial and operational environments. The role focuses on maintaining plant availability and reliability through planned maintenance and timely response to mechanical failures, in accordance with workplace health and safety, environmental, and quality requirements.

Key Responsibilities
• Execute planned and preventative maintenance activities in accordance with maintenance schedules, work instructions, and engineering standards
• Inspect, service, maintain, and repair heavy duty mobile plant and equipment, including trucks, loaders, drills, ancillary plant, and production support equipment used in industrial operations
• Diagnose mechanical and hydraulic faults using appropriate diagnostic tools, instruments, and procedures
• Remove, overhaul, repair, or replace mechanical and hydraulic components such as pumps, cylinders, valves, drivetrains, suspensions, braking systems, and structural assemblies
• Perform precision fitting, alignment, and adjustment of components to ensure correct operation and tolerances
• Lubricate machinery and maintain fluid systems in accordance with manufacturer and site requirements
• Respond to plant breakdowns and unplanned maintenance events to restore equipment to operational condition
• Safely use lifting equipment, hydraulic jacks, and workshop machinery to handle large assemblies and components
• Conduct routine inspections to identify wear, defects, or emerging mechanical issues
• Recommend corrective and preventative measures to improve plant reliability and reduce unplanned downtime
• Collaborate with supervisors, planners, and other maintenance personnel to coordinate maintenance activities
• Maintain accurate maintenance records, job reports, and inspection documentation
• Comply with all workplace health and safety, environmental, and quality management systems
• Participate in hazard identification, risk assessments, and incident reporting processes

Skills and Experience
• Demonstrated experience maintaining and repairing heavy duty mobile plant, machinery, and industrial equipment
• Strong mechanical fitting background, with sound knowledge of hydraulics and associated mechanical systems
• Experience diagnosing faults in complex plant and machinery environments
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, manuals, and specifications
• Competence using hand tools, precision measuring equipment, hydraulic testing tools, and workshop machinery

result.description:
A Building Associate supervises construction sites and organises and coordinates the material and human resources required for a project.

Role Overview
Phoeniks is seeking an experienced Building Associate to supervise and coordinate the construction-related aspects of its ventilated ceiling installation projects nationally. The role sits within Phoeniks' technical and construction supervision function, assisting Construction Managers, Architects and Engineers in the planning, feasibility assessment, and on-site delivery of ventilated ceiling works across commercial, healthcare and institutional projects.

The successful candidate will act as Phoeniks' supervising construction sites, coordinating labour and materials, interpreting plans and codes, and ensuring works are feasible, compliant, and delivered to specification.

Key Responsibilities
1. Assisting Construction Managers, Architects and Surveyors in Planning and Organisation
- Support Construction Managers, Architects and Engineers in planning and organising ventilated ceiling works, including sequencing, access and integration with the broader head-contractor construction program
- Provide technical input during project planning, value engineering and problem-solving stages, working closely with the Product Manager and Technical Manager

2. Interpreting Plans, Regulations and Codes of Practice
- Read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, specifications and construction documentation for ventilated ceiling installations
- Interpret and apply Australian Standards, building codes, and WHS regulations relevant to ceiling and building services works

3. Preparing Preliminary Sketches, Working Drawings and Specifications
- Prepare preliminary installation sketches and site-specific working drawings for ventilated ceiling systems
- Develop method statements and installation specifications tailored to individual site conditions

4. Preparing, Editing and Revising Plans, Maps, Charts and Drawings
- Edit and revise installation drawings, ceiling layout plans and services coordination charts in response to site conditions, clashes or design changes
- Liaise with the Product Manager – Ventilated Ceilings on drawing updates arising from product-specific requirements or site variations

5. Coordinating Works Programs
- Coordinate ventilated ceiling installation programs and sequencing across multiple sites nationally, aligning with the head contractor's overall construction program
- Supervise and support installation teams and subcontractors to ensure correct methods, sequencing and workmanship
- Assist with commissioning and handover activities as required

6. Inspecting Work and Materials for Compliance with Specifications, Regulations and Standards
- Attend project sites to inspect in-progress and completed works, ceiling structures, and materials for compliance with drawings, specifications and Australian Standards
- Conduct quality checks, identify defects, risks or required rework, and provide clear technical feedback to internal teams
- Ensure all site activities comply with WHS regulations, site safety plans and Phoeniks procedures

7. Calculating Costs and Estimating Time Scales
- Estimate installation time scales, labour requirements and material costs for ventilated ceiling projects, feeding into project programs and budgets
- Assess the technical feasibility of proposed installations prior to project confirmation, identifying risks, constraints and cost implications for internal teams

8. Collecting Data Using Surveying Instruments and Photogrammetric Equipment
- Collect on-site measurement and survey data — levels, dimensions, structural grid and services coordination data — using appropriate surveying and measuring instruments
- Record site conditions using photographic and measurement-based survey methods to support pre- installation feasibility assessments

9. Performing Routine Computations and Plotting Preliminary Data
- Perform routine dimensional, load and quantity computations to support installation drawings and material take-offs
- Plot preliminary layout and survey data to inform installation planning and drawing preparation

Training & Knowledge Transfer
- Train Phoeniks installation teams and subcontractors nationally on ventilated ceiling systems, promoting best-practice installation methods and quality standards across all regions
- Develop and deliver practical, on-site and workshop-based training sessions

Skills & Experience
Essential
- Relevant qualification or at least three years of relevant industry experience
- Proven experience supervising construction sites, ceiling systems, HVAC-related installations, or building services installations
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and construction documentation
- Strong understanding of site conditions, services coordination and construction sequencing
- Ability to collect and interpret site survey/measurement data and perform routine technical computations
- Willingness and ability to travel nationally on a regular basis
- Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with Construction Managers, Architects, Engineers and internal teams

Desirable
- Experience with ventilated ceilings, chilled beams, or integrated ceiling systems
- Trade or associate-level qualification in construction, mechanical services, or a related field
- Experience working on healthcare, commercial, or large-scale construction projects
- Familiarity with Australian Standards and building codes relevant to ceilings and services
- Registration or licensing relevant to building supervision (where applicable)

SUMMARY:

Mon morning

Fri morning

- Expected salary: $80,000 per year

## ICT Customer Support Officer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Customer Support Officer to join our team and deliver high-quality technical assistance to end users across the organisation. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues, supporting the deployment and maintenance of computer infrastructure, and ensuring staff can make effective use of technology in their day-to-day work. You will bring strong communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. This position is well suited to a detail-oriented professional who thrives on problem-solving and is committed to delivering outstanding service.
## Key Responsibilities
- Respond promptly and professionally to user queries regarding hardware and software problems, providing clear guidance and timely resolutions via phone, email, or in person
- Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues across a range of systems, applications, and devices, escalating complex matters to senior technical staff where appropriate
- Assess software and hardware requirements to develop practical solutions that meet user and business needs
- Install, configure, and update software applications and operating systems, ensuring compatibility and optimal performance across user environments
- Adapt and modify existing programmes and applications to align with evolving user requirements and organisational workflows
- Repair, replace, and maintain peripheral equipment including printers, terminals, modems, and other connected devices
- Assist in the implementation and maintenance of computer networks, contributing to the configuration and ongoing support of network infrastructure
- Support the design, maintenance, and updating of websites and internal digital platforms as required
- Promote and educate end users on the efficient and effective use of applications, equipment, and IT systems to maximise productivity
- Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, and equipment inventory using ticketing and asset management systems
- Contribute to the development and documentation of IT support procedures, user guides, and knowledge base articles
- Provide support within a call centre environment where required, handling a high volume of inbound technical queries with professionalism and efficiency
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate IV or Diploma in Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
- Demonstrated experience in an ICT support, help desk, or technical services role
- Solid understanding of computer hardware, software applications, and operating systems (Windows and/or macOS)
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral equipment
- Familiarity with networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic network troubleshooting
- Proficiency in using IT ticketing and asset management systems to log, track, and resolve support requests
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues methodically and efficiently
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users
- Customer-focused attitude with a professional, patient, and approachable manner
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and perform effectively under pressure
## Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft 365 Certified, or ITIL Foundation
- Experience supporting users in a call centre or high-volume help desk environment
- Knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and remote desktop support tools
- Familiarity with website content management systems (CMS) and basic web maintenance tasks
- Experience working within ITIL or other IT service management frameworks
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth
- Access ongoing training, certifications, and career development opportunities to advance your ICT career
- Enjoy flexibility in your working arrangements, with a consistent and structured shift schedule to support work-life balance
- Contribute to meaningful work that directly supports staff productivity and organisational success
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, recognising your skills and experience
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
